single.title: An elevated train in the city
prompts: Add a narrow cobalt-blue stripe beneath the train's side windows, retaining all signs and numbering. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Fit a small protective metal grille around the front coupler, without changing the coupler position. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a small rectangular inspection hatch to the lower front panel. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Give that hatch four visible corner fasteners. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a slim rain deflector above the front destination display, keeping 'Kimball' legible. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a short pair of windshield-wiper arms resting along the front windows' lower edges. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Place a small trackside equipment cabinet beside the rightmost rail, outside train clearance. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Give the cabinet a yellow triangular lightning warning symbol. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a narrow grated maintenance walkway along the elevated structure's right edge. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Fit a simple metal safety railing along the new walkway. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Slightly raise the viewpoint, retaining the train front, full visible consist, and clock tower. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a compact track signal beside the new walkway in the middle distance. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Illuminate the signal's green lamp with a restrained glow. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a small identification plate reading 'R2' below the signal. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Give the clock tower's upper balcony a slender decorative metal railing. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a small weather vane on the clock tower roof. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Slightly extend the canvas leftward with matching rooftops and city vegetation. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Add a compact row of rooftop planter boxes on the left flat building roof, away from the tracks. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
Plant low ornamental grasses in those rooftop boxes. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.

Shift the scene to soft early-evening light, with gentle warm reflections along the silver train panels. Retain the blue train stripe, coupler grille, inspection hatch, and green signal. Keep all other details and prior edits unchanged.
shortPrompts: Add a cobalt stripe beneath the train windows.
Fit a protective grille around the front coupler.

Add a yellow lightning warning to the cabinet.
Build a grated walkway along the right edge.
Fit a safety railing to the walkway.
Raise the viewpoint slightly.
Place a track signal beside the walkway.
Illuminate the signal's green lamp.
Add an 'R2' plate below the signal.
Add a decorative railing to the tower balcony.
Place a weather vane on the clock tower.
Extend the city rooftops leftward.
Add planter boxes to the left flat roof.
Plant low grasses in the rooftop boxes.
Shift to soft early-evening light.
